completed_units: Consumed the accepted D24 UR/JT0 parent and the existing D25 observer/shell/I1/I0 checkpoints without reopening them; LIFT remains exactly W_p congruent p modulo p^3 at the surviving observer.

For I0, proved that U0,U1,U2 are exactly the zeroth, first and second coordinates of the single finite parameter jet F_n(epsilon), identified U0 as an alternating binomial transform with a pulled-back Gauss 2F1 system, and ruled out naive exact antisymmetric k<->n-k cancellation while preserving the fixed k=m source.

Introduced the global finite polynomial P_n(epsilon)=sum_{k=0}^{p-1} c_k(-n+epsilon)_k with n=(p-1)/3 and proved exactly W_p=P_n(p/3); because all denominators are p-units for k<p, its second-order Taylor jet at epsilon=0 is lossless modulo p^3.

For every tail port k=n+r proved (-n+epsilon)_{n+r}=epsilon(-n+epsilon)_n(1+epsilon)_{r-1}, hence defined one canonical tail chain d_r=c_{n+r}n!(r-1)! with P_n'(0)=-U1+sum d_r and P_n''(0)=U2+2 sum d_r(H_{r-1}-H_n).

Proved the exact tail valuations v_p(d_r)=0 for 1<=r<=m, 1 for m<r<=2m, and 2 for 2m<r<=4m, and the exact rational recurrence d_{r+1}/d_r=3r(p+3r+1)(2p+6r+1)(2p+6r+5)/[4(p+3r+2)^3(2p+6r-1)]; the former I1/I2 boundaries are exactly the valuation-jump edges r=m and r=2m.

Derived the strict observer-equivalent carrier W_p congruent U0-(p/3)U1+(p^2/18)U2+(p/3)sum_{r<=2m}d_r+(p^2/9)sum_{r<=m}d_r(H_{r-1}-H_n) modulo p^3. The discarded tail terms are removed only by proved p^3 invisibility. The old I1 and I2 normalized carriers are respectively the unit and one-p-divisible projections of the same d_r chain.

Executed the exact modular checker on all 166 target primes p<5000, 83 in each residue class: global-jet identity, tail valuation strata, exact cross-multiplied recurrence and both jump edges all pass with zero failures. Checker SHA-256 is 20772740f3471bf4b4a6454bb3c384c9ebc1aff7471f47df5fcb5e1882b7b1e1; finite regression is falsification only.
